title: New in Germany: the first 30 days – checklist
desc: Checklist for your first 30 days in Germany: registration, tax ID, bank account, health insurance, broadcasting fee, children, German course. 13 languages.
h1: New in Germany: the first 30 days – step by step
intro: This list shows what to do after moving to Germany, and in which order. Tick off the steps you have done – your progress is only saved on your device.
tips: Keep a copy or photo of every letter and application.
Open every letter from an authority immediately – deadlines start when you receive it.
Don't understand a letter? Use our translation help and the deadline calculator.
steps: Your landlord must confirm in writing that you moved in. You need this form to register.
within 2 weeks of moving in (§ 17 BMG)
Bring your passport or ID and the landlord confirmation. Many cities give appointments online.
After your first registration, the Federal Central Tax Office sends your tax ID automatically by post. Keep it safe – your employer needs it.
Everyone legally resident in the EU has the right to a basic account (Basiskonto). The bank must offer it within 10 business days of your application (§ 31 ZKG).
Everyone living in Germany must have health insurance (§ 193(3) VVG). If you work, choose a health insurance fund and tell your employer.
One fee is paid per home. If your home is not registered yet, you must register it. People receiving e.g. Grundsicherungsgeld or AsylbLG benefits can apply for an exemption.
before your visa or permit expires
Non-EU citizens: apply for your residence permit or extension in good time before it expires.
Work or money to live on
Register as a jobseeker or apply for Grundsicherungsgeld. Benefits are usually paid only from the date you apply.

Apply for child benefit (Kindergeld) at the Familienkasse – whether you are entitled also depends on your residence status. Register for a daycare place early; register school-age children with the school or school office.
Check whether you are entitled to an integration course or can apply for admission.
